messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Materials on lavaan estimation outcomes
parts: a paper or material  where lavaan mediation analysis are explained? I am conducting analysis in lavaan with categorical variables.

This book is pretty thorough, but the software is Mplus:  https://www.statmodel.com/Mplus_Book.shtml

Yves has some slides here:  https://www.da.ugent.be/cvs/pages/en/Presentations/Presentation%20Yves%20Rosseel.pdf
I don’t know how to explain some of the outcomes especially threshold and variances.

Understanding those has nothing to do with mediation.  You can read about the threshold model and latent-response interpretation in these papers, or in many SEM textbooks:

https://doi.org/10.1080/10705510701758406

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3162326/

https://www.statmodel.com/download/webnotes/CatMGLong.pdf

https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11336-016-9506-0.pdf
